source.publication: 2025 IT-540 Louisiana Resident Income Tax Return Instructions (Revised 7-26)
source.section: Form IT-540 (PDF page 3) Lines 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, 13; instructions PDF page 3, Lines 7 to 13; rate: PDF page 1 What's New

worked: Federal AGI = wages (person 0) 40,000.00 = 40,000.00. Federal taxable income = 40,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction = 24,250.00 (given, not tested; the federal senior deduction is ignored). Filing status 3 on Form IT-540. Louisiana starts from federal AGI. No Schedule E adjustments. IT-540 Line 7 federal AGI 40,000.00. Line 8 standard deduction (filing status 3) 12,500.00. Lines 9A to 9D skipped (no federal itemizing). Line 10 = 40,000.00 - 12,500.00 = 27,500.00. Line 11 = 27,500.00 x .03 = 825.00. Line 12 credits 0.00. Line 13 = 825.00.
